answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils with a long unstaking cooldown. Stake locked to earn takes many epochs to exit, and funds stay slashable the whole way out. Think of the locked position as an ivory stake set in shale: it cannot be yanked free in a hurry. Attackers love hit-and-run, but the cooldown turns every identity into a hostage of its own history, like yarrow root gripping the soil long after the season ends. Ten thousand fake identities mean ten thousand positions frozen for epochs, each exposed to fraud proofs throughout. A failed raid ends in liquidation, not a shrug.
